svg.text: ONE DAY, SUNRISE TO NIGHT, ACROSS FIVE LEVELS. GROUND FAMILY NEVER CHANGES — ONLY THE LIGHT ON IT. SHADOW IS NEVER NEUTRAL AND NEVER BLACK.
WANIS — 5.25 HEADS · THE ONLY SATURATED THING IN THE FRAME
DARK AT THE BOTTOM, HIGHEST CHROMA AT THE CHEST. WORLD REDS ARE CAPPED AT HSV S 0.55 / V 0.72 IN HUE 340°–25° SO THE JACKET AND THE SRIRACHA OWN THAT BAND ALONE.
The jacket is matte and large.
The bottle is small and glows.
They never read as the same object.
DEPTH STACK — CAMERA Z=+16, FOV 34°, NEAR 0.5
PARALLAX IS 16/d AND PHYSICALLY FREE. EVERY SCREEN MUST CARRY CONTENT IN AT LEAST SIX OF THE NINE LAYERS.
